recommendation: Keep this core audit commit as-is. Future substantive changes to coding-conformance should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by reintroducing the removed extension row into core.
issue_request: FHIR-25212 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested a standard extension on Coding with value type canonical(StructureDefinition) so implementations can declare which profile(s) a Coding is included for conformance purposes.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in core by ec83d5b505, an MnM non-substantive R5 batch that explicitly listed FHIR-25212 and added a conformance row to source/datatypes/coding-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for Coding with 0..* cardinality and canonical(StructureDefinition) value type.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed the coding-conformance row from source/datatypes/coding-extensions-spreadsheet.xml as part of moving extensions out of the R5 source. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout defines input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-coding-conformance.xml with the expected canonical URL, Coding context, and canonical value constrained to StructureDefinition, and its IG includes input/definitions/* as resource input scope. Core still retains the extension OID in source/oids.ini.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The reconciliation is an empty external-repo audit commit because the current core checkout intentionally lacks the extension definition and the maintained artifact is present in the FHIR Extension Pack.
